escena: SCENE (on-location product shoot in a small ceramics workshop, 11 am, filming a launch video): in focus, a camera operator in a plain dark grey sweater holds a compact cinema camera on a shoulder rig and watches its bright field monitor, one hand on the focus wheel; the cool light of the monitor lifts the cheek and hand. Behind, SOFT and out of focus, the potter at the wheel under warm window light. 50mm f/1.8. LENS FRAMING (essential): the operator's face, hand and the glowing monitor sit together inside ONE circle whose diameter is about 60% of the frame width, centred at 40% of the frame width and at 40% of the frame height, with air around it. The LOWER 35% of the frame holds only calm, evenly shadowed floor and a dark workbench, nothing essential. Nobody looks at the lens. No readable text on the monitor, completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the dark edge of the workbench right at the lens
